output: On April 23rd, a Russian SU-27 fighter aircraft performed an aggressive maneuver towards a US RC-135U plane in the Sea of Okhotsk, reportedly armed with air-to-air missiles. This event occurred amid ongoing tensions between the US and Russia over Ukraine, with both nations' defense officials later discussing the incident.

Prince Charles and Camilla travel on a 12-day tour, celebrating Charles' 67th birthday in Western Australia, meeting Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull, and visiting 12 towns and cities in Australia and New Zealand, marking their 15th visit to Australia, following William and Kate's successful visit the previous year.
A 70-year-old woman was attacked in Sneem, County Kerry, on September 20, and a man was detained by officers in Killarney and is currently being questioned at the Killarney Garda station.

A former GP, Hugh McGoldrick, was removed from the medical register on March 29th after the Medical Practitioners Tribunal reported no appeal to their earlier findings against him for falsifying drug trials on sleep disorder patients between 2007 and 2008 at his clinic in Downpatrick.

A 21-year-old male is under police questioning on suspicion of murder following the discovery of a body in a wooded area in Dorking. The nature of the location and the identity of the deceased are not revealed in the article.
A man named Josh Hanson was fatally stabbed at the RE bar in Eastcote, and Scotland Yard is urging anyone with information about the incident, as no arrests have been made yet.

A company is considering launching a potential ferry service between Sandown and Southsea, aiming to boost tourism, which would operate four times a week in July and August, subject to obtaining necessary approvals, and the service details are still being finalized with the Isle of Wight Council regarding the use of Sandown Beach.
A 30-year-old man was arrested for a violent attack by up to eight individuals in the Heights area at 2:00 BST on Sunday, with police appealing for information on the incident.

Correction: The floods in Assam, India have led to over 100 deaths, affected 450,000 people, and displaced many residents. Additionally, Prime Minister Narendra Modi is due to visit Assam to address the annual flooding issue, which has also been affecting millions across at least 20 states in India this year.

The 25th anniversary Premier League season kicks off with Arsenal hosting Leicester City on Friday, 11 August, and Sky Sports is granted the rights to broadcast 10 Friday night matches in their latest multi-million pound deal with the league.

Oldham Athletic Football Club dismissed player Cristian Montano, who had 48 appearances and scored four goals for the team, following an investigation into spot-fixing. The club acted swiftly in dismissing Montano, according to a club statement.

A 20-year-old man was sentenced to a suspended jail term and a year's supervision order for starting a fire at a former resort in Brixham, Devon, in 2014, causing extensive damage to the 42-acre site. The prosecutor stated that the fire increased the final cost of demolition due to the presence of asbestos, but the article does not confirm whether the fire made it more difficult to isolate and remove asbestos.

Scottish midfielder Gary Wilson joined Nottingham Forest from Celtic for £2.5m in 2013, but is currently without a team after his release in May 2019, having made 51 appearances at the City Ground in his second spell with the club.

Australia loses to Sri Lanka by 82 runs in the second ODI, with Nathan Coulter-Nile (3-45) and debutant Amila Aponso (4-18) starring for the hosts. Matthew Wade topscored with 76 for the visitors, making the series score 1-1 after two matches each.

Vadim Cobilas, Sale's first Moldova international in the Premiership, is moving to France's Top 14 at the end of his contract, joining Bordeaux. The team is also in advanced talks with David Seymour, Will Addison, and Mark Jennings for new deals, while the futures for Chris Cusiter and Tommy Taylor remain unclear.

India's pursuit of 349, initially at 277-1, crumbled to 323 all out, resulting in a loss with Kane Richardson taking 5-68. This collapse followed impressive knocks by Aaron Finch (107) and David Warner (93) for the home team. The Australian series currently stands firmly in their favor at 4-0, aiming for a whitewash in the final match in Sydney.

The Hammersmith and City Line and partly the Circle Line have been temporarily suspended due to a request from the London Fire Brigade, as concerns of debris falling onto the tracks arise from a fire at a 24-story block in London.
Kilmarnock announces the return of 27-year-old Jamie Hamill, who previously played for the club, on a three-year contract.
Ross Morgan, an Ipswich fan, accidentally punched a hole in his ceiling while celebrating Paul Anderson's goal, and Anderson later offered to cover the repair costs.

Retailers in Cardiff are required to keep tobacco products obscured from public view, facing potential fines and imprisonment for non-compliance, a move intended to improve public health by reducing the attractiveness of smoking, as explained by Public Health Wales.

The 20-year-old player Lucas, who has previously scored three goals in 10 appearances for the National League side this season, is expected to contribute to Bristol Rovers' squad as a substitute, given his goal-scoring potential and threat to defenses, as suggested by manager Luke Garrard.

Knaresborough station in North Yorkshire is undergoing restoration, involving waterproofing and the removal and rebuilding of its chimney stack on the signal box. Night-time work on the platform canopy is planned to minimize disruption, as noted by Network Rail. The historically significant station is under the management of train operators Northern.

The article details that former NFL player Lawrence Phillips, who had a history of legal troubles and assault convictions, is believed to have committed suicide while in prison, facing charges for the death of Damion Soward, though the method of suicide remains unclear. The sentence length detailed in the article is not specified.

The Belfast Rapid Transit (BRT) proposal aims to extend bus lane hours from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, seven days a week, to establish 12-hour bus lane priorities. The project will be subject to consultation in both East and West Belfast, potentially including flexible loading and unloading windows based on stakeholder and community feedback. The project is set to commence operation in September 2018.

In the Italian third and fourth divisions, around 70 people, comprising players, directors, and officials from approximately 30 clubs, have been detained under suspicion of conspiracy to commit sporting fraud, with some alleged links to the 'Ndrangheta crime syndicate, as part of an ongoing investigation led by prosecutors in Catanzaro.

Spiderlings of a hybrid species, consisting of species found in Sussex and Suffolk, were released in Castle Marshes, funded by the BBC Wildlife Fund and jointly organized by Natural England and Suffolk Wildlife Trust, with the aim to potentially enhance the local population's ability to adapt to climate change.
The Partition of India, on August 7, 1947, resulted in the independence of two new countries (Pakistan and India), causing a mass displacement as millions of people became refugees.

Iva Barr, a seasoned marathon runner in her 20th event, had to withdraw from the London Marathon early and complete the remaining distance via a train and walking, yet still described the day as a "great day" with encouraging spectators.

In China's top cities, a surge in property demand has led some young couples to resort to fake divorces to afford multiple homes due to high prices and low wages, despite central bank efforts to curb rising property costs.

A 46-year-old landlord, Mr Jones, died at The Blossoms public house, and a 24-year-old man was arrested for murder. Police are particularly interested in witnesses on the number four Arriva Bus that was caught in traffic near the Black Bridge area around the time of the incident.

A red Ford Fiesta and a white Asda delivery van collided near Carsphairn, resulting in the deaths of drivers Scott Kennedy and Antony Sztuka, both from Ayrshire. The A713 was closed for several hours, and police are seeking information from witnesses, particularly about a white flat-bed pickup truck that was on the road at the time of the crash.

Australian rower Sarah Tait, who won a silver medal in the 2012 London Olympics alongside Kate Hornsey, was diagnosed with cervical cancer in 2013 and was an inspiration to many young athletes due to her strength and influence, with rivals Heather Stanning and Helen Glover acknowledging her impact on women in sport.

Two separate suicide bombings, claimed by the Taliban, occurred in Kabul on the inauguration day of the new Afghan President Ashraf Ghani, causing injuries on a military bus in western Kabul and another location in northeast Kabul. The attacks were part of an ongoing offensive that started in the summer, as per Taliban's claims on Twitter. The U.S-brokered unity deal allows President Ghani to share power with runner-up Abdullah Abdullah, who becomes chief executive.

Daimler expects significant growth in full-year sales, despite a slowdown in Mercedes sales in China, and although growth rates in China and India will be notably lower than the preceding year, there is still confidence in growth prospects in major emerging markets.

A 10-year-old son of Crown Prince Frederik was saved from a potentially life-threatening situation in a rip current on Mermaid Beach by lifeguard Nick Malcolm. Although Danish officials maintained that the prince was never in real danger, lifeguard Stuart Keay affirmed that Malcolm's intervention might have been crucial for the young prince's survival.

Firefighters and police attended a fire at the intersection of Elgin Road and Inchbroom Road on Wednesday at 16:10, where they found an elderly man deceased. The investigation is ongoing, with initial inquiries suggesting no suspicious circumstances, and no other injuries reported.

Veterans with complex amputation-related complications can now receive specialized treatment at the Defence Medical Rehabilitation Centre (DMRC) in Surrey, marking an expansion of healthcare services for veterans, a move that follows a decade of managing military trauma injuries by DMRC staff.
Four 50mph enforcement cameras installed in a two-mile stretch at Port Talbot resulted in approximately 125 daily speeding violations, down from around 700 daily during the pilot period.
The Manchester-born teacher in Spain is suspected of secretly photographing students and storing sexually explicit files involving minors after an Interpol investigation led to his arrest.

A seven-year-old sturgeon named Steve, who had previously escaped from World of Water in Romsey, Hampshire during the February floods, was rescued from a deep puddle near a car wash a mile away, leaving center staff "hugely relieved." The missing koi carp fish Chadwick remains unaccounted for.

Chris Rock, a renowned comedian and actor, has filed for divorce from his wife Malaak Compton-Rock after 19 years of marriage. The couple, parents to daughters Lola Simone, 12, and Zahra Savannah, 10, are prioritizing privacy and family well-being during the divorce process.

A multi-vehicle collision on a motorway near Tamnamore, between junctions 13 and 14, led to a closure of the road in both directions and resulting in extensive traffic backups. Authorities advise motorists to exit at junctions 15 (for Belfast) and 12 (for Armagh city and Enniskillen), and they are asking anyone with information about a specific Honda Civic involved in the incident to contact the police.

The French government has proposed Laurent Stefanini as the new ambassador to the Vatican, but the Vatican's delayed response could indicate potential rejection, given Stefanini's past service in the Holy See and France's stance on same-sex marriage.

The Nasdaq suffered its largest one-day decline since April 10, 2014, decreasing 2.4% primarily due to steep drops in semiconductor and biotech stocks, with specific examples including AMD and Oramed Pharmaceuticals. The decline in durable goods orders in February might have contributed to this, though the article does not establish a direct cause-effect relationship. The dollar's strength relative to the euro was a potential factor, as suggested by Anthony Karydakis. The merger between Kraft Foods and Heinz increased Kraft's stock by over 35%.

Vondrousova, ranked 233 in the world, claimed her first ATP title in the women's tournament at Grand Prix Hassan II by beating Kontaveit 6-4 7-6 (6) after defeating Strycova in the semi-final, moving her close to the top 100. Meanwhile, Coric, world number 79, fought back from five match points down against Kohlschreiber to win his first ATP title at the Grand Prix Hassan II, having trailed 3-0 in the second set and 4-2 in the decider.
Stoke City signs 28-year-old forward Eric Choupo-Moting, known for his international career, as their fourth summer transfer acquisition.

"A man with cerebral palsy, Seamus McCollum, died at a Randalstown private nursing home in Northern Ireland last September, and the death was classified as a murder only in April following an autopsy, with a woman currently being questioned by police."

Heavy rains in India's Tamil Nadu state have resulted in waterlogging on major streets, causing a citywide standstill, forcing the closure of offices, schools, and colleges, and affecting at least 80,000 people in the region and northern Sri Lanka. The Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu has announced a relief fund for flood-affected areas.

A McGill's bus caught fire outside Largs on the A760 Kilbirnie Road around 13:35 on Saturday, with the driver ensuring everyone safely exited the bus without injuries, even as the vehicle was partially destroyed by the blaze.

In the 2016 County Championship, 25-year-old Jake Ball, who showcased assured performances in the initial matches, leads the wicket-taker list, having impressed his teammates and directors with his improved fitness, dynamism, and productive winter preparations, resulting in him heading the Notts' bowling attack with the new ball alongside Stuart Broad.

The memorial stone, made from Jersey granite and unveiled in Guillemont, France, honors 120 "Jersey Pals" who died in the Battle of the Somme. A core from the middle of the stone, symbolizing a person's heart, will be brought back to Jersey to become part of a monument in Royal Square.

Twenty-four-year-old "Star Wars: The Force Awakens" actor John Boyega, a former member of Theatre Peckham from ages nine to 14, has expressed his eagerness to contribute back to the theater as a graduate of their company.

In Thailand's championship, Thailand's Aphibarnrat and Fitzpatrick lead with 12 under par, while Luke Donald is 4 shots behind and Lee Westwood is 6 shots behind after impressive rounds. Bradley Dredge withdrew due to a viral infection, forfeiting a potential opportunity for the lead.

In the County Championship match, Middlesex lost their openers early as Nick Gubbins was caught off the bowling of Tino Best, and Sam Robson edged Tino Best to Jimmy Adams. However,Ashton Agar (Voges) and Dawid Malan's 279-run third-wicket partnership put Middlesex in a strong position for their first win of the season, with Ashton Agar (Voges) scoring a century (128*) and Malan making 147 before getting dismissed.

A 52-year-old woman died and a 16-year-old boy is critically injured, while a 54-year-old man sought by police has been located in a different region, following an incident on Penilee Road. Forensic investigations are ongoing at the scene.

The anonymous telephone bidder purchased a three-bedroom house at 9 Newcastle Road, previously lived in by John Lennon of The Beatles from birth to the age of five, after a competitive bidding war, with a final selling price within the given guide price range and located near Penny Lane, made famous by The Beatles.

A 29-year-old, Aaron Joseph, has denied owning a dog involved in an incident which led to the death of David Ellam, and he also pleaded guilty to possessing cannabis. The cause of Ellam's death as reported in the article is not specified as being from a dog attack.

A body believed to be 22-year-old Thomas Bebbington, last seen near Dana Steps in Shrewsbury, was found on private land near Leighton, approximately 10 miles away from Shrewsbury city centre, as confirmed by West Mercia Police.
Tiny otter pups need six daily feeds and are expected to be moved to a larger, outdoor enclosure with a pool in the summer, where they'll be fed live food when they become more independent.

A 33-year-old mother-of-four, Joanne Thompson, was found deceased at her Old Mill Court home in Newtownards. Police are investigating, seeking witnesses to a disturbance at a Monday bonfire on Dakota Avenue and any activity around her home on Tuesday night and early Wednesday morning.

A record-breaking 2,270 black-tailed godwits, including some from Europe, spent spring in a small field in Kilmoluaig, Hebrides, during their migration to Iceland, nearly doubling the previous record set in 2013.

A rare albino deer, estimated to occur in 1 out of 100,000 births, is receiving attention at a wildlife park.

A 14-year-old named Asad Khan died three weeks after starting at Beckfoot Upper Heetan School, and his family suspect he may have been bullied, with an inquest into his death possibly revealing more details next month.

The restored painting, unique in its depiction of the 1654 coronation, has been displayed in Rokeby Park since 1880, with its origins and creator still unknown amidst the park's collection of valuable artworks.
Macclesfield Town win 3-0 against Wrexham, with goals from Danny Rowe, Mitch Hancox, and Danny Whittaker, moving them up to seventh in the table, while Wrexham stay in 15th.

The 2017 Africa Cup of Nations finals in Gabon sees a new sponsorship deal with French oil and gas company Total, marking a significant milestone in African football's development. The precise financial value of the deal has not been disclosed as yet.

Spain coach Julen Lopetegui includes Diego Costa and Juan Mata in the squad for upcoming international matches against Belgium and Liechtenstein, following their omission from the Euro 2016 squad, while Fabregas, Pedro, David de Gea, Adrian, Cesar Azpilicueta, David Silva, Nolito, and others are also included.

A large, deliberately-started wildfire has spread over a 5km area and crossed the border, making it one of 435 incidents reported since early May. The fire is promoting urgent warnings about the dangerous and reckless nature of such actions.

Cricket player Boyd Rankin, who previously played for England in 2014 but had limited chances, is rejoining Ireland after securing a meeting with Cricket Ireland last week. This comeback is timely as it aligns with the upcoming World Twenty20 in India and Ireland's strive for Test status, with Rankin expressing eagerness to potentially help Ireland achieve Test status.

The Northern Ireland Rare Disease Partnership, formed with the Patient Client Council, aims to educate, provide specialized services, and advocate on behalf of individuals and families affected by rare diseases.

The Dean of Gloucester Cathedral announced plans to introduce girl choristers, aiming to discover talented young singers from diverse backgrounds for a full-time program starting rehearsals in September and singing at regular services from October. The initiative will include auditions for girls on 23 April.

Professional soccer player Pedro, aged 29, was hospitalized and sustained a concussion after Chelsea's 3-0 win in Beijing. Upon returning to training, he is expected to wear a protective mask. The team is currently preparing for upcoming matches in Singapore, against Bayern Munich on Tuesday and Inter Milan on 29th July.

James Taylor, a former England cricketer who retired due to a heart condition, is now sharing his extensive one-day cricket experiences with Nottinghamshire and Yorkshire's academies by offering advice and insights, while Alex Sales, former Northants captain, is focusing on improving the technical aspects of the county's batsmen's game after his retirement in 2014.

On Friday afternoon at about 15:00 GMT, an incident unfolded on Whiterock Road, during which a man was charged with criminal damage, disorderly behavior, and assault on police. Witnesses to the incident, including children, were reportedly waiting to pick up prescriptions.

The vessel's engine failed a mile northeast of Muck Island, and the Larne RNLI launched two lifeboats despite good weather conditions. They successfully towed the yacht to Carrick Marina, showcasing effective collaboration between their inshore and all-weather lifeboats.

Both managers remarked on the exciting and frustrating game, with Ipswich's Mick McCarthy and MK Dons' Karl Robinson noting the game's reflection of their respective seasons and the learning curve for their teams.

On Saturday, 27 August, a bridge collapsed on the London-bound carriageway of a motorway, injuring a motorcyclist with broken ribs. The driver of the vehicle involved was subsequently issued a summons to appear before Maidstone magistrates, facing charges of dangerous driving, causing serious injury by dangerous driving, and three counts of criminal damage. The incident occurred between junctions four and three, near the M26, resulting in the road's closure twice over the following week for debris removal.

A German youth group, organized by several Germans on social media, staged a false celebrity-chase scenario in Platja d'Aro, leading to a panic with 11 treated for bruises, heart palpitations, and 3 hospitalizations; the perpetrators were detained and charged with public order offenses. The president of Catalonia condemned the incident and praised the town council and police for their response.

A gorse fire on Woodbury Common in Devon has caused four instances of smoke inhalation and one case of burns, as authorities battle the blaze that has engulfed a large area of heath-land. The difficult-to-control fire, fanned by high winds, is being fought on multiple fronts and will continue into the early hours of Monday morning, with a "very large" fire front present on numerous parts of the common. The nearby Woodbury Park Golf and Country Club has been evacuated, and smoke can be seen for miles around, prompting public warnings to avoid the area.

The British Speedway Promoters' Association, led by chairman Keith Chapman, secures a 15-year lease for the club's Beaumont Park venue and plans further meetings to establish the management structure, schedule a 2017 season race night, and finalize other arrangements.

A 50-year-old woman, Elizabeth Bowe, was found injured at Bobby Jones Place in St Andrews on September 17. She died three days later in Ninewells Hospital. Her brother, Charles Gordon (aged 51), is charged with murder. The investigation will focus on the initial police response, with a report from the Police Investigations and Review Commissioner (PIRC) submitted to the Crown Office and Procurator Fiscal Service (COPFS) in due course.

Ross County signs Jim O'Brien, a 29-year-old midfielder, on a two-year contract, with the hope that he can help develop younger players. His availability for the Scottish League Cup match depends on international clearance.

In Division Two, Northants exploited Durham's fragile batting line-up, dismissing key players such as Jennings, Steel, Clark, Collingwood, and Richardson. Durham's bowlers managed to take some wickets, but Northants ended the day trailing by 107 runs with 59-3, having struggled in response to Durham's score, with Durham having recently suffered a defeat by Glamorgan.

A 19-year-old New Zealander is one shot behind joint leaders Brooke Henderson, Lee Mi-rim, Gerina Piller, Brittany Lincicome, and Catriona Matthew, with Henderson and Lee sharing the lead at two under, Catriona Matthew is three strokes back on one over par, and the remaining four players are under par after two rounds at the Sahalee Country Club.

Billy McCall, a 56-year-old former player with Aberdeen and coach with Scotland, Birmingham City, Hibernian, Motherwell, and Rangers, is returning to the Scotland national team coaching staff, this time as an assistant to manager Gordon Strachan, for the upcoming World Cup qualifiers after previously working under Alex McLeish during the Euro 2008 qualifying campaign.

The Giants secured a 5-4 victory over Belfast, with Colin Shields scoring the initial goal, Scott Aarssen equalizing late in the first period, and Ryan Martinelli, Mark Garside, Alex Foster, and Steve Saviano adding additional goals, with the Clan visiting Belfast in the following game.

Jordan Spieth, the defending Masters champion, suffered a sudden collapse on the 12th hole, leading to a quadruple-bogey seven and a victory for Danny Willett – the first Englishman to win since Nick Faldo in 1996. This collapse, and its similarities to Faldo's win in 1996, have left Spieth stunned.

The trial is ongoing for optometrist Honey Rose, accused of gross negligence manslaughter, as the prosecution alleges her failure to detect a patient's swollen optic discs during a routine eye test at Boots in Ipswich led to his death five months later.

Food price inflation increased to 4.9% in June, surpassing analysts' expectations and approaching the government's target figure of 3.5%, with pork prices playing a significant role. This development reduces the possibility of interest rate cuts in 2013 to avoid overheating the property market amidst global economic uncertainty. China plans for GDP growth of 7.5% this year, which would be the slowest rate since 1990, and the government will release the second-quarter GDP data on July 15.

Former Newcastle United and Ivory Coast international Cheick Tiote, 30, died after collapsing during training with Chinese second-tier side Beijing Enterprises on 5 June. A memorial service was held in his honor, attended by friends, family, and team-mates from his previous clubs.

British rider Geraint Thomas of Team Sky advances to sixth place overall in the race, after teammate Simon Yates (Orica-Scott) withdrew during stage five. Slovakia's Peter Sagan wins the stage, with Thibaut Pinot of France moving into second place overall, behind leader Nairo Quintana of Colombia.

Cuadrilla's plans for fracking at the Preston New Road site in October were approved, with the aim of stimulating job creation, new skills, investment, and community initiatives in Lancashire, despite an ongoing legal challenge. While it is expected that up to half of the estimated £50m spent during the exploration phase could be spent in Lancashire, not all the money will directly result from the fracking project.

Three missing males from north-west London, suspected of planning to travel to Syria, were arrested by Turkish officials upon their return, bailed, and subsequently released without charge. This followed an international police hunt launched weeks earlier for three schoolgirls from east London, who are believed to have traveled to Istanbul and joined IS militants in Syria.

In the 2016-17 season, Swansea's development squad secured the league title with a draw against Wolverhampton Wanderers and a cup final win, amassing 31 victories overall, and the senior team narrowly evaded relegation.

The severe storms in December 2013 caused damage to the narrow dune system near Barkby Beach in Prestatyn, leading to concerns about its vulnerability. To combat this, the Denbighshire council is considering creating a secondary dune system to strengthen its defenses and has discussed potential solutions with Natural Resources Wales to reduce the flood risk.

The FA Cup tie between semi-professional clubs South Shields (Northern League Division One) and Bridlington Town (Northern Counties East League), previously Wembley finalists, will be live-streamed and commentated by Conor McNamara and Danny Webber on 19 August at 12:30 BST, with audience interaction through #bbcfacup.

A targeted attack occurred at Craigmillar Castle Road, resulting in a 38-year-old man sustaining serious, non-life threatening injuries, while a 49-year-old victim did not need medical attention. Police are seeking information about suspicious behavior and vehicles in the area around the time of the incident.

A 51-year-old woman, Pamela McLaggan, pleaded guilty to manslaughter of Jonathan Baines, 44, known as "Willy," who was found dead on Ropery Road, Gainsborough, on August 1. She is scheduled for sentencing on December 21 after it was noted that Mr. Baines had spent the day at Market Rasen races and visited pubs in Gainsborough upon his return.

A 15-year-old boy was assaulted by a man and woman in their 40s on a train between Glasgow Central and Neilston at Patterson station, sustaining facial injuries but not requiring hospital treatment. His mobile phone was stolen. British Transport Police are seeking witnesses to the incident.

A 17-year-old from Dewsbury was questioned under the Terrorism Act in April and later released on bail, while the investigation continues into the potential joining of Islamic State by him and a friend, who are feared to have disappeared in March. The Great Britain ice hockey team, consisting mainly of players who previously won a silver medal at the 2015 World Championship (Division 1B), has named their 22-man squad for the tournament against hosts Italy, Netherlands, and Serbia. The winners will progress to final qualifying for the 2018 Winter Games in PyeongChang, with the series against the host club Cortina scheduled to take place in Belfast during the tournament.

Matthew Perry is considering taping a tribute to Friends creator James Burrows, but this is not a long-awaited Friends reunion. The tribute special is scheduled to air on NBC on February 21, and features the original cast members Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, David Schwimmer, and Matt LeBlanc. Jones, who began his career at Manchester United and joined the Clarets in 2013 after playing for various clubs including Preston, Derby, Blackburn, Wolves, and Oldham, started their Premier League game with Swansea after helping the Clarets win the Championship title in 2013.

Murdered Melbourne lawyer Joe Acquaro, known for representing crime bosses, is suspected by investigators of being targeted by underworld figures due to his past clients, as tensions between criminal organizations continue to persist in the Australian city despite a previous gangland feud ending over a decade ago.

Air France Flight 374 from Paris to Vancouver was diverted to Prestwick, Scotland, on July 15, 2017, due to a slight smell of burning on board, with a replacement aircraft being sent to return passengers to Paris CDG.

A yellow severe weather warning has been issued for coastal areas and north-western parts of Wales, with the remnants of Hurricane Gonzalo expected to bring strong winds and heavy rain, with the strongest winds predicted on Tuesday.

A 34-year-old man from Poole was charged with causing grievous bodily harm, while a 57-year-old woman was arrested for grievous bodily harm with intent and perverting the course of justice, in connection with the death of 64-year-old Kenneth David Dickie, who was found with a serious head injury at the Rockley Park site in Poole on 8 May and subsequently died at Southampton General Hospital on the same day, Sunday 8 May.

A missing construction worker, Christopher Huxtase from Swansea, was found deceased on Wednesday, ending the search, while two other workers, Ken Cresswell and John Shaw, remain missing following the February collapse of a site destined for demolition.
Bristol City seeks a win against QPR to potentially move closer in the league standings, aiming to challenge for a higher position.

Astronaut Luca Parmitano, picked by ESA in 2009, called spacewalking "absolutely fantastic" and felt "giddy with excitement" during his 2013 mission that involved two spacewalks, 2,656 orbits, and a total travel distance exceeding 110 million km at the International Space Station.

English rugby league player Joe Arundel, who made 44 appearances for the Tigers and scored 16 tries from 2008, is expressing excitement and a little nervousness about joining Hull FC, seeking a new challenge and a different culture, with Hull FC director of rugby Shaun McRae highlighting the club's aim to foster a winning mentality by recruiting players of Arundel's potential and promise for both Hull FC and England.

Ulster Bank's parent company, RBS, is working to resolve payment issues affecting around 600,000 customers, with Ulster Bank promising to ensure no customers are left out of pocket. Historically, RBS has faced IT failure issues similar to this one in 2012, but the banking group claims to have invested hundreds of millions of pounds to improve their computer systems since then.

Tanzania led Kenya 2-1 in the 2016 Women's Africa Cup of Nations qualifier, with Omari Mwanahamisi scoring twice for Tanzania and Christine Nafula responding for Kenya. In a separate match for third place, Ethiopia defeated Uganda 4-1.

McDonald's Japan is currently rationing French fries due to an industrial action in America, causing a shortage of potatoes, with the first shipments of additional potatoes starting to arrive this week.

Cracksman, who previously beat Permian in the Derby Trial, is the favorite in the upcoming Classic on 3 June. The race will feature additional horses such as Permian (winner of the Dante Stakes at York) and Khalidi (most recent winner at Goodwood).
